propositions: Tolerant Pydantic parsing in verify_models.py can normalize structurally divergent provider output to an empty result, which was incorrectly treated as a valid review outcome

Semantically empty verifications (raw-empty or malformed-to-empty after reshape) must never produce a valid pass review, but decision-correctness is already enforced by pass3_decide's no-verification rule routing to indeterminate

Telemetry must distinguish four outcome buckets (clean, recovered, empty_outcomes, unrecoverable) at the kernel-function level via verify_findings(), but pipeline-level wiring into production workflows is incomplete
Flexible parsing and bounded retry/self-healing behavior must be preserved across provider and model versions while preventing recovery attempts from masking semantically empty responses

The shipped verify_findings() implementation and unit tests (test_review_kernel.py) satisfy all acceptance criteria at the kernel level, but integration into plan_review_decide and code_review_decide workflows is tracked as a separate follow-up ticket
